title: Раскаяние Насти и наряд полиции  (Nastya's Remorse and the Police Raid)

segments.t: With everyone gathered in the office, Nastya tearfully confesses to her father and Kostya that she staged her own kidnapping because her homeless friends desperately needed money. Just as she begs their forgiveness, a squad of police officers called by her mother raids the kitchen.
Я думал, мы доверяем друг другу.
Командир, я не понял, вы откуда взялись-то?
Let's replay the exchange and look closely at each Russian phrase.
'What the Chef did not know.' Nastya explains that what the Chef did not know, keeping her voice calm and direct.
'Was that I bought them myself.' Realizing that was that he bought them himself changes how Barinov handles the situation.
'They needed the money very badly.' Noting that they needed the money very badly keeps Kostya's side of the story simple and clear.

'Could you not simply have asked me for it?' Asking whether Barinov not simply have asked her for it is how Nastya puts Barinov on the spot. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
'You could have at least warned me.' Admitting that Kostya could have at least warned him shows Barinov being honest for a change.
Я думал, мы доверяем друг другу.
'I thought we trusted each other.' Saying that he thought they trusted each other is how Kostya sets the tone with Barinov.
'Kostik, please forgive me.' Over the conversation and the forgiveness, Nastya answers Barinov without a second thought.
'Dad, forgive me.' With the work and police in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct.
'Forgive me, all of you.' Over the work and the police, Kostya answers Barinov without a second thought.
'The restrooms and locker rooms are clear.' Since the restrooms and locker rooms are clear, Nastya does not waste words on excuses.
'Go check the storage room.' Going check the storage room is how Barinov lays out the situation for Kostya.
Командир, я не понял, вы откуда взялись-то?
'Officer, I do not understand, where did you guys come from?' Kostya asks whether officer he does not understand where did Barinov guys come, refusing to let the point slide.

'I was the one who called them.' Because she was the one who called them, Nastya treats the matter as settled. Russian drops "is" in the present, setting the two halves of the thought side by side. Let's hear the complete conversation once more.
Я думал, мы доверяем друг другу.
Командир, я не понял, вы откуда взялись-то?

That wraps up this scene as nastya confesses to her father and Kostya that she staged the kidnapping to help her homeless friends, right before police officers summoned by her mother storm in. Until next time!
